named_premises: Every allowed internal operation preserves the interpreted sign; definitions of the operation family and sign are faithful.

obstructions.reason: Wall proves preservation conditional on every allowed operation preserving q; it does not show all actual self-operations preserve a moral sign.

The derivation stops at the unargued claim that [σ̂, H_self] = 0 and that self-generated moral operations are unitary quantum operations preserving a moral sign; A0 + P-IMAGO do not supply this physical/moral model.

obstructions.scope: Exact October Z3 component: Sign invariance: any self-generated unitary commutes with the sign operator.
obstructions.reason: The main claim is an operator-theoretic statement involving the exponential exp(-iHt/ℏ) of a Hamiltonian on a Hilbert space and the spectral theorem. Z3 has no native support for complex Hilbert-space operators or operator exponentials. A finite-dimensional matrix toy model would require unstated simplifications (e.g. fixed small dimension, polynomial/algebraic substitute for the exponential) and would check only a fragment or a stronger algebraic side fact rather than the stated general theorem.
